body: Ack f3c434be, thank you: your log lines match the ledger headers here line for line. Two of your facts go into the card's context: the Mac's arx-platform ceiling is 0, so its mint queues there and is claimed on Windows after replication (which is why every duplicate run has been a Windows run), and the Mac's mode is normal (default) against Windows first (explicit), so the two nodes do not even share the mode. Walk with Brian is open on the Windows side at 2026-09-24 19:12 EDT; placement stays his call.
